The City of Buckeye executed a development agreement with AZLCO Buckeye, LLC (Ordinance No. 08-24, adopted unanimously 2024-08-06). It reimburses the developer for six enumerated regional infrastructure components it builds and dedicates to the city — two public-safety sites, temporary and permanent public-safety facilities, $15M toward the Johnson Road interchange, and oversized regional water infrastructure — funded by 20% of the tax revenue the project itself generates, beginning only after the city has received $60M cumulatively and terminating 20 years from the effective date. It is capped at "the lesser of" the developer's verified costs or $50,000,000, so it cannot exceed what the developer actually spent; it is cost recovery for public infrastructure rather than an incentive, abatement or credit, and is therefore not recorded as a subsidy. Nothing has been paid to date. Buckeye's economic-development director has projected "more than 360 jobs at full build out" — an end-state across as many as 40 separate future data centers, none yet leased, permitted or built, and so not recorded as a permanent-jobs figure for this site. A search of 226 Buckeye Council and P&Z agendas (Feb 2024 – Aug 2026) found no GPLET and no Foreign Trade Zone instrument.

fac.nt: 1.5GW campus proposed on the Falls Ranch property spanning the Natrona/Converse county line near I-25, roughly 10 miles east of Casper. Site plan still in flux as of July 2026, with developers weighing an alternate parcel south of I-25; targeted operational by 2028.

fac.n: Related Digital Cheyenne Data Center Campus
fac.nt: 115-acre campus in the Cheyenne Business Parkway; up to 302 MW of critical IT capacity across the full campus. CoreWeave is the anchor tenant under a long-term lease for 88 MW of critical IT capacity — the 88 MW is the leased slice, not the campus total. Phase I projected to generate over $250 million in tax revenue to Wyoming and Cheyenne in its first 15 years. Coordinates approximate the Cheyenne Business Parkway, not a parcel-confirmed point.
